name: ESWATINI

flag.title: Shield & Spears
flag.note: Blue, red & yellow — shield unites all

lead: Eswatini is a small kingdom between South Africa and Mozambique. It has no coast. You could drive across it in two hours. It has tall mountains, wildlife plains and royal traditions. The king's family has led the Swazi for over 200 years.

facts.label: Land area
facts.sub: Smaller than Wales or New Jersey

sections.animals: Big game in a tiny kingdom
sections.history: From Ngwane III to Mswati III
sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: Eswatini slopes down from cool mountains in the west to hot, flat savanna in the east. Malolotja Falls plunge 89 metres. Four zones fit into one tiny country.
The Ezulwini Valley means 'Place of Heaven'. It holds the royal palace and parliament. Nearby, Sibebe Rock is a granite dome three billion years old.
animals: Hlane Royal National Park shelters white rhinos, elephants, lions, giraffes and hippos. Rangers guard the rhinos closely. This makes Eswatini a rhino success story.
The rare blue swallow breeds here. Over 500 bird species have been recorded. Impala, kudu and zebra graze the plains.
culture: Every August, up to 40,000 unmarried girls gather for the Umhlanga Reed Dance. Each girl cuts a tall reed and gives it to the Queen Mother. Then they dance in beaded costumes.
Each December, the Incwala ceremony renews the king's power with six days of ancient songs. Swazi craftspeople make woven baskets and hand-poured candles sold worldwide.
history: The Swazi kingdom took shape in the mid-1700s under King Ngwane III. King Mswati II grew it so large that the people took his name. British protection began in the 1890s. Independence came in 1968.
In 2018, King Mswati III renamed Swaziland as Eswatini, meaning 'Land of the Swazis'. It was the 50th independence anniversary. He is Africa's only remaining absolute monarch.
wows: Eswatini is Africa's last absolute monarchy. The king holds full power.
Sibebe Rock is 3 billion years old, one of Earth's largest granite domes.
Tiny Malolotja reserve is a rare breeding site for the blue swallow.
Eswatini is Taiwan's only official ally in Africa.
The lilangeni is pegged 1:1 to the South African rand.
Eswatini is Africa's 4th-biggest sugar producer, yet smaller than Wales.
Up to 40,000 people join the Umhlanga Reed Dance each year.

myths.fact: Lesotho and Morocco are kingdoms too. Lesotho is even surrounded entirely by South Africa.

myths.myth: A rhino's horn is made of bone
myths.fact: It is made of keratin, the same stuff as your fingernails and hair.
